name: How long does a typical sticking window repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sticking window repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sticking window repair depends on the complexity of the problem. Simple repairs, such as cleaning and lubrication, might take an hour or less. Repairs involving the replacement of a sash balance or minor wood repair could take a few hours. More extensive issues, like significant frame repair or multiple window adjustments, might require a full day or staggered visits. A professional can provide a time estimate after assessing the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; simple fixes take under an hour, while replacing parts or repairing wood could take several hours to a full day, depending on complexity.
